# Cut-day checklist

Do not start this page until `tools/pilot.py precut <GARMENT>` prints READY TO CUT. The cut is
the irreversible step and everything before it exists to be recoverable.

## Before you pick up the shears

- [ ] `tools/pilot.py precut` prints READY TO CUT and lists no blocks
- [ ] The printed cut packet is on the table (`tools/pilot.py packet <GARMENT> --out ...`)
- [ ] Both offcut labels are written: `<GARMENT_ID>_OFFCUT_L` and `_R`, where L and R are the WEARER's left and right
- [ ] The second person is here

## Marking

The cut is a straight line PERPENDICULAR TO THE LEG'S CENTRE LINE through the inseam at the
target length. It is NOT square to the inseam. Measure the target length down the inseam, and
the target length PLUS the printed offset down the outseam, then join the two marks with the
straightedge. On a leg tapering from a 60 cm thigh to a 40 cm opening that offset is about 18
mm; ignoring it cuts a line the software did not predict.

- [ ] `MARKED.CUT.LEFT.MARK_MACRO` — Left leg
- [ ] `MARKED.CUT.RIGHT.MARK_MACRO` — Right leg, same frame as the left
- [ ] `MARKED.CUT.ANGLE_LEFT` — Left leg, straightedge laid on both marks
- [ ] `MARKED.MEASURE.LEFT.INSEAM_TAPE` — Left leg flat and straight
- [ ] `MARKED.MEASURE.LEFT.OUTSEAM_TAPE` — Left leg
- [ ] `MARKED.CUT.ANGLE_RIGHT` — Right leg, straightedge on both marks, full leg width in frame
- [ ] `MARKED.MEASURE.RIGHT.INSEAM_TAPE` — Right leg, tape along the INSEAM from the crotch seam to the mark
- [ ] `MARKED.MEASURE.RIGHT.OUTSEAM_TAPE` — Right leg, tape along the OUTSEAM to the mark, including the offset
- [ ] `MARKED.PREDICTION.OVERLAY_COMPARISON` — Print or display the cut overlay the tool generated and photograph it beside the marked garment, or photograph the marked garment and hold the printed overlay in the same frame
- [ ] `MARKED.WHOLE.FRONT_OVERHEAD` — Garment front-up, marked, laid exactly as for the before-state overheads: waistband at the top, legs parallel at the frozen gap, board flat in its usual corner

## Verification

- [ ] Second person measures BOTH marks on BOTH legs with a tape
- [ ] Every reading agrees with the packet within **3 mm**
- [ ] Verification recorded: `tools/pilot.py confirm <GARMENT> cut_marks_verified --verifier NAME --measured-inseam N --measured-outseam N`
- [ ] Confirmed the legs will be cut SEPARATELY: `... confirm legs_cut_separately`
- [ ] Confirmed the offcuts will be kept and labelled: `... confirm offcuts_retained_labelled`

## Cutting

- [ ] Legs cut one at a time, garment flat, one continuous stroke where possible
- [ ] Cutting tool and operator name recorded
- [ ] Both offcuts labelled IMMEDIATELY, before they leave the table
- [ ] Any cutting irregularity noted and photographed

Once two offcuts are in two wash conditions, an unlabelled swap is unrecoverable evidence
loss. Label them before they move.
